race.comment: THE LOCAL (2) embarrassed his rivals here on debut when scoring arrogantly. Promising type that's irresistible not to follow up on. CLASSIC TOUCH (3) returns and was well supported throughout last prep before tackling a deep CL2 at Hawkesbury. Has peaks that give this a big shake. Will be looking for further after this but with the blinkers applied he should be sharp. WILLINGHAM (11) worked home nicely into third here last start and strips rock-hard fit. Carries the big weight but draws well with Boudvillain sticking. JUNGLE LIGHTS (4) has been consistent on wet ground and had merit in her Gundagai third after racing wide throughout. Keeping safe for a minor spot.
